Modified 2026-10-24 for Noqui backwear research: extracted static native cuboids, remapped texture resource names, recentered and uniformly scaled geometry, and replaced display settings for ItemDisplay FIXED.
Per-face UVs divided by source Blockbench resolution and multiplied by 16; UV order and face rotations retained. Organizational groups have no rotations. Embedded PNG bytes decoded verbatim. World-block cullface flags omitted for an isolated item display. Animated PNG strips retain original pixels with generated mcmeta from the source frame_time.
Octagonal round shield built from cuboids, distinct from the tall shield.

Assets explicitly released under CC0 in the upstream README; optional attribution retained.
Original sources remain under upstream/ and are identified by SHA256 in candidates.json. Changes are reproducible with normalize_assets.py.
